purpose: Deterministically construct an explainable Protocol 7 roll pool without a generic bonus-die channel.

input.ability_dice: three dice resolved from skill registry and character state

pipeline.rule: Convert ranks to exactly one ordinary Skill die using core breakpoints; never progress beyond d12.
Add the three Ability dice named by the canonical Skill record, preserving duplicate Ability references.
Add only legal relevant Gear dice. Default primary relevant gear limit is one unless an explicit rule overrides it.
Apply only explicit VAM operations. VAM-added dice retain source_type=vam and are not renamed Advantage.
Expand active Condition effects into named restrictions and/or Disadvantage sources.

Collect every named Advantage and Disadvantage source. Until the interaction rule is locked, do not silently cancel or stack multiple sources; mark GM_RESOLUTION_REQUIRED when interaction is ambiguous.
If and only if the Skill is Mastered and an explicit legal access mechanism grants access, add one Mastery die equal to the current ordinary Skill die.
Every die must have source_type, source_id/reason, die size, and mechanical role. Reject unexplained dice and numeric +N modifiers.
Show the player every die grouped by Skill, Ability, Gear, VAM, Advantage, Disadvantage, and Mastery with a human-readable reason.

hard_failures: gear die with no relevant gear source
audit_note: The evaluator deliberately does not invent the unresolved multi-source Advantage/Disadvantage interaction rule. It can be implemented now and will surface that case instead of guessing.
